degenerateReason: A string function over a non-string operand is a CEL type error that denies every seed. A store coercing the number to text would return rows.
intent: contains() on a string attribute with a numeric attribute as the needle (R.attr.aString.contains(R.attr.aNumber)).
trap: A non-string needle is a CEL error; concatenating the number into a LIKE pattern coerces it to text and returns rows.
